The pipeline transport distance used in the model is 100 miles, with low-end sensitivity value representing a transport distance of 50 miles and high-end sensitivity value representing a transport distance of 250 miles. Inventory data related to saline aquifer storage of CO is sourced from the FE/NETL CO Saline 2 2 Storage Cost Model (NETL, 2017a). • Impacts related to facility construction and equipment manufacturing were estimated using EPA’s U.S. Environmentally-Extended Input-Output (USEEIO) model (2017). Items with capital cost were mapped to sectors as defined by the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS), and the costs for these line items were run through USEEIO to estimate emissions associated with the production or consumption of goods and services in the given sectors. This sector mapping is summarized in Exhibit 2-13, which aligns with the capital cost tables of the TEA. Impacts of facility construction were then normalized by lifetime ammonia production, which is calculated as the annual facility ammonia production capacity multiplied by the facility lifetime.
